'''Lopin''' was the servant of [[Nalesean Aldiaya]]. 

== Appearance ==
He had dark skin, a fat gut, and was balding. He had a blocky face, was stout, and had a beard that nearly reached his chest.

== Activities ==
He was always complaining about [[Talmanes Delovinde]]'s servant [[Nerim]]. He was with the [[Redarms]] when they traveled to [[Ebou Dar]]. After Nalesean's death, [[Matrim Cauthon]] took Lopin to be his servant along with Nerim.
 
He then stayed in the [[Tarasin Palace]] with Mat and began to transfer Mat's clothes and all his money back into the [[Wandering Woman]]. Mat sent Lopin and Nerim to collect all the stored money and meet him outside the city when Mat carried out his plan of escaping with the captive [[Aes Sedai]].

He then caught up with Mat and traveled in [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]] as cover for their escape.

After the Band set up camp a league outside [[Caemlyn]], Lopin was murdered by the ''[[gholam]]'' that was hunting Mat. {{Ref/book|13|9}}
